modelAnswer:
Dear Chris,
How are you doing back in Ireland? I often think of the China-Ireland Cultural Festival, where we first met.

I still remember the evening you taught me an Irish folk dance. I kept stepping on your feet, but you just laughed. In return, I showed you how to write your name in Chinese with a brush.

The festival meant a lot to me. Through our talks, I learned about Irish music and history. Better still, I am no longer afraid of speaking English with people from abroad.

I hope we can keep in touch. Shall we have a video chat once a month? If you come to China again, I'll show you around.
Yours,
Li Hua

taskRequires: 身份和读者：李华写邮件给在“中国-爱尔兰文化节”上认识、现已回国的爱尔兰朋友 Chris。
三个要点：回忆活动经历；分享个人收获；希望保持联系。
格式：书信邮件，自己写称呼和署名；词数 80 左右，可适当增加细节。
taskCard.thisEssayChooses: 本范文把“活动经历”落在一件互相教的小事上：他教我跳爱尔兰民间舞，我教他用毛笔写中文名字；收获写成了解爱尔兰音乐和历史、敢开口说英语；结尾提议每月视频一次。语气是朋友之间的亲切随意。这些细节都可以换成你自己的经历。

pointMap.quote: I still remember the evening you taught me an Irish folk dance.
Through our talks, I learned about Irish music and history.

notes.role: 问候朋友，点出两人在文化节相识，引出回忆。

items.quote: How are you doing back in Ireland?
items.explain: 先关心对方回国后的近况，朋友之间这样开头比直接说“我写信是为了……”更自然，也照应了题面“他已回国”。

items.quote: the China-Ireland Cultural Festival, where we first met
items.explain: 用 where 从句把活动名称和“我们在这里认识”合成一句，一句话交代清楚两人的关系从哪里开始。

notes.role: 回忆活动经历：写一件具体的小事，而不是笼统地说“玩得很开心”。

items.quote: I still remember the evening you taught me an Irish folk dance.
items.explain: 把回忆落到一个具体的晚上、一件具体的事，读者马上能想起那个场景；the evening 后面直接接定语从句，省掉了 when。

items.quote: I kept stepping on your feet, but you just laughed.
items.explain: 一个小尴尬加上对方的反应，有画面、有情绪，朋友读了会笑，比“we had a good time”有温度。

items.quote: In return, I showed you how to write your name in Chinese with a brush.
items.explain: In return 说明这是一来一往的交流：他教我舞蹈，我教他书法，正好扣住“中爱文化节”的文化交流。

notes.role: 分享个人收获：知识上的收获和自己的变化各一句。

items.quote: The festival meant a lot to me.
items.explain: 先用一句短句总说收获，再分两层展开，读者一眼看出这一段在讲什么。

items.quote: Better still, I am no longer afraid of speaking English with people from abroad.
items.explain: Better still 把第二个收获往上推一层：从“知道了什么”到“我变成了什么样”，收获写得更真实。

notes.role: 希望保持联系，并给出具体的联系办法。

items.quote: Shall we have a video chat once a month?
items.explain: 光说“保持联系”是空话，这一问给出了具体做法和频率，Chris 读完可以直接回答好不好。

items.quote: If you come to China again, I'll show you around.
items.explain: 再发出一个邀请，让联系不止停在网上，结尾落在两人以后还能做的事上。

expressions.function: 回忆共同经历时，引出一个具体的时刻或场景。
概括一段经历对自己的意义，接着再说具体收获。
表达保持联系的愿望，并用商量的口吻提出具体办法。

advanced.essay:
Dear Chris,
It has been a month since you flew back to Ireland, and I still miss the days we spent at the China-Ireland Cultural Festival.

I can never forget the evening you taught me an Irish folk dance. I kept stepping on your feet, yet you just laughed it off. The next day it was my turn to be the teacher: I helped you write your name in Chinese with a brush, and you proudly hung it up.

Those few days taught me more than any textbook. Your stories about Irish music and history made a faraway country feel close. More importantly, I am no longer shy about speaking English with people from abroad.

Let's not lose touch. How about a video chat once a month? I'd love to hear about your life, and if you ever come to China, I'll be your guide.
Yours,
Li Hua

pointMap.quote: I can never forget the evening you taught me an Irish folk dance.
Your stories about Irish music and history made a faraway country feel close.

beyondStandard.quote: The next day it was my turn to be the teacher
beyondStandard.explain: 标准版用 In return 交代互教，这里用“轮到我当老师”接住上一句他教我跳舞，角色一换，交流的来回更有画面；后面他把字骄傲地挂出来，又写出了对方的反应。

beyondStandard.quote: made a faraway country feel close
beyondStandard.explain: 标准版只说学到了音乐和历史，这里说出这些故事对自己的影响：遥远的国家变得亲近，收获从知识落到感受上。
朋友之间更口语的说法，比标准版的 I hope we can keep in touch 更亲近；后面再用 How about … 提办法，语气轻松不生硬。
